items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: In fact I had Jack play out at the Norris Country Club. And he had a job earlier and I told him, I said don't worry, I'll play for a half hour until you get there.

ctx.x: But a lot of these bass players, when they start playing flat at 13ths and flat at 14ths and flat at 18ths, they don't know what the fuck they're doing. They're just hitting them on. I mean Tony Lausa is another one of those great. He can sing the Bachemagula or something like that but he can't play all the things you are. Is that right? No kidding. No. No bass. Jack Abel let him go. And Jack's got a pretty keen ear.
